whatItDoes.text: The company says it is a technology company that makes digital technology and AI widely available responsibly.
whatItDoes.quote: Microsoft is a technology company committed to making digital technology and artificial intelligence (“AI”) available broadly and doing so responsibly.

whatItDoes.text: The company says it develops and supports software, services, devices, and solutions that create new value for customers.
whatItDoes.quote: We develop and support software, services, devices, and solutions that deliver new value for customers and help people and businesses realize their full potential.

howItMakesMoney.text: The company says it earns revenue by offering cloud‑based solutions, AI, software, platforms and content to customers.
howItMakesMoney.quote: We offer an array of services, including cloud-based solutions that provide customers with AI, software, services, platforms, and content, and we provide solution support and consulting services.

howItMakesMoney.text: The company says it generates revenue from a wide range of cloud solutions, content, licensing, advertising and device sales.
howItMakesMoney.quote: We generate revenue by offering a wide range of cloud-based solutions, content, and other services to people and businesses;

source.label: 10-K filed July 29, 2026 · Item 7, Management's Discussion and Analysis

competitiveEdge.text: The company says its global cloud scale and identity‑security portfolio let it solve complex cybersecurity challenges better than rivals.
competitiveEdge.quote: our cloud’s global scale, coupled with our broad portfolio of identity and security solutions, allows us to effectively solve complex cybersecurity challenges for our customers

marketPosition.text: The company says its goal is to lead the industry in several technology areas over the long term.
marketPosition.quote: Our goal is to lead the industry in several distinct areas of technology over the long term, which we expect will translate to sustained growth.

marketPosition.text: The company says Microsoft Cloud revenue grew 27% to $214.4 billion, showing its leading market position.
marketPosition.quote: Microsoft Cloud revenue increased 27% to $214.4 billion.

source.label: 10-K filed July 29, 2026 · Item 7, Management's Discussion and Analysis

industryTrends.text: The company says its industry is dynamic, highly competitive and sees frequent technology and business‑model changes.
industryTrends.quote: Our industry is dynamic and highly competitive, with frequent changes in both technologies and business models.

source.label: 10-K filed July 29, 2026 · Item 7, Management's Discussion and Analysis

industryTrends.text: The company says each industry shift creates opportunities for new products, technologies or ideas that can transform the business.
industryTrends.quote: Each industry shift is an opportunity to conceive new products, new technologies, or new ideas that can further transform the industry and our business.

source.label: 10-K filed July 29, 2026 · Item 7, Management's Discussion and Analysis

demandDrivers.text: The company says demand for Azure and other cloud services drove a 41% revenue increase.
demandDrivers.quote: Azure and other cloud services revenue grew 41% driven by demand for services across the platform with continued growth across all workloads.

source.label: 10-K filed July 29, 2026 · Item 7, Management's Discussion and Analysis

demandDrivers.text: The company says Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud growth was powered by higher revenue per user from Copilot and E5.
demandDrivers.quote: Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud revenue grew 17% with growth in revenue per user driven by Microsoft 365 Copilot and Microsoft 365 E5.

source.label: 10-K filed July 29, 2026 · Item 7, Management's Discussion and Analysis

biggestRisks.text: The company says intense competition across all markets could hurt its results of operations.
biggestRisks.quote: We face intense competition across all markets for our products and services, which could adversely affect our results of operations.

biggestRisks.text: The company says its cloud and AI strategy needs large investments and depends on customer demand, technology and regulation, any of which could harm the business.
biggestRisks.quote: Our cloud and AI strategy requires substantial investments and depends on evolving customer demand, technological developments, competitive dynamics, and regulatory conditions, any of which could adversely affect our business

biggestRisks.text: The company says cyberattacks and security vulnerabilities could reduce revenue, raise costs or damage its reputation.
biggestRisks.quote: Cyberattacks and security vulnerabilities could lead to reduced revenue, increased costs, liability claims, or harm to our reputation or competitive position.

outlook.text: The company says it will keep looking for datacenter expansion and more server capacity to meet evolving customer needs, especially for AI.
outlook.quote: We continue to identify and evaluate opportunities to expand our datacenter locations and increase our server capacity to meet the evolving needs of our customers

source.label: 10-K filed July 29, 2026 · Item 7, Management's Discussion and Analysis

dropped.text: The company says its Microsoft Cloud integrates across the technology stack, offering openness, faster value, lower cost and greater agility.
dropped.quote: Our Microsoft Cloud provides integration across the technology stack while offering openness, improving time to value, reducing costs, and increasing agility.

dropped.text: The company says its investments in cloud, AI infrastructure and devices will raise operating costs and may lower operating margins.
dropped.quote: Our investments in cloud and AI infrastructure and devices will continue to increase our operating costs and may decrease our operating margins.
